objective: Enable a camera, see honest tracking, calibrate and independently check pointing, practice, recover and return naturally

contract.name: Reach Phase 1 observation, calibration and laboratory foundation

experienceIntent.objective: Point at calibration targets using my real hand and understand whether I can act
experienceIntent.visibleOutcome: Detected hand, tracking quality, gesture classification and calibration eligibility remain visibly distinct
experienceIntent.persona: A Creator or Player completing the named human objective
experienceIntent.accessibility: Provide keyboard/touch operation and a meaningful supported alternate experience.

baselineDebt.deficiency: Hand detection can be confused with action eligibility, producing misleading calibration feedback.

experienceIntent.limitation: This campaign defines the required experience and tracks existing debt; it does not implement Spatial Experience Refit.

experience.persona: A Creator, Player or owner exploring local hand interaction with an ordinary webcam
experience.objective: Enable a camera, see honest tracking, calibrate and independently check pointing, practice, recover and return naturally
experience.visibleOutcome: A coherent staged camera and pointing workspace with visible acquisition, distinct recognition stages, safe recovery and independent results
experience.accessibility: Keyboard, touch and ordinary buttons operate setup, pause, retry, deletion, export and return. A disclosed guided demo explains the full flow without a camera.
experience.fallback: Camera failure gives a plain-language explanation, retry and a guided conventional demonstration. All Voyagewright navigation remains conventional.
experience.navigation: Existing device connections link opens Reach; the visible return clears owned camera resources and restores device connections; safe contextual return is accepted.
experience.designTarget: One continuous instrument workspace with a large registered camera stage, restrained brass and sea-green hierarchy, staged target plane, contextual guidance, visible progress and deliberately disclosed diagnostics. Mobile preparation prioritizes the camera and calibration prioritizes the target.

references.reason: Accepted public entry establishes hierarchy and a coherent shell around distinct role destinations.
references.preserve: Visible account access, clear destinations, cinematic composition and a usable reduced-motion equivalent.

references.reason: Accepted constrained gateway keeps the same destinations and account access.
references.preserve: Mobile task hierarchy, readable controls and contextual navigation.

motion.measurement: Visible-control activation to changed rendered readiness or next-stage outcome; software UI feedback only, excluding camera exposure or inference accuracy

continuity.objective: Maintain the existing Voyagewright origin and navigation destination before, during and after local camera/observation/calibration work; no pairing or progression authority moves into Reach.

limitations: D0 and photographic D1 replay do not establish real-person webcam accuracy, field ergonomics or owner acceptance.
Absolute empirical RGB pointing is experimental and must pass held-out validation for the current setup; relative cursor control has distinct setup and claims.
Camera movement can be undetectable. Calibration is session-only and must be repeated after placement, identity or geometry changes.
Phase 2 target selection, Phase 3 manipulation and Crossdeck Air Handoff are not implemented by this laboratory.

journeys.outcome: A person enters naturally, understands tracking, completes nine training and five independent targets, practices, sees detected ineligible hands and safely returns
